items.title: Chicago Hotel Strike Hits Marriott and Hilton Hotels During Marathon Weekend
items.snippet: Skift Take: Owners, not brands, carry most of the payroll burden. " But owners see things differently. Hundreds of union workers walked out of six downtown Chicago hotels Friday, two days before the Chicago Marathon, and their union warned that 40 more hotels could follow.

items.title: Rwanda gears up to host Formula 1 Grand Prix
items.snippet: Rwanda reportedly lined up to host the F1 Grand Prix in 2030.

items.title: Braemar advances Ashford spinout with $372M Four Seasons sale
items.snippet: With the Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale under contract and a settlement agreement reached in its dispute with shareholder Al Shams, Braemar is on track to transition to self-management.

items.title: Market Beat Germany - H1 2026
items.snippet: German hotel investment volume fell to €600M in H1 2026 from €1.1B a year earlier, while operating metrics held steady with RevPAR flat at €74 and prime yields stable at 6.5%.

items.title: Scapia, Tourism Malaysia launch campaign to explore newer destinations
items.snippet: Scapia and Tourism Malaysia have partnered to launch ‘Malaysia Calling’, a four-month campaign encouraging Indian travellers to explore destinations beyond popular holiday hubs such as Kuala Lumpur and Genting Highlands. The initiative will showcase Malaysia’s diverse tourism offerings while providing promotional benefits on eligible travel bookings.

items.title: WTTC study finds SME productivity could unlock USD 63 billion
items.snippet: The World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) has highlighted the economic potential of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), with new research indicating that a 10% productivity improvement could generate an additional US$63 billion in direct Travel & Tourism GDP across eight major economies.

items.title: Tivoli to Open 71-Key Aarunya Club & Convention in Greater Noida
items.snippet: Tivoli Hospitality Group will open Aarunya Club & Convention by Tivoli in Greater Noida on November 15, 2026, with 71 rooms and an expanded portfolio of indoor and outdoor event venues targeting weddings, social celebrations, leisure stays and the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE) segment.

items.title: We really try to bring reliability and quality within the leisure market: Caroline Mulliez of The Blue Kite by Vianaar
items.snippet: The Blue Kite, the holiday-villa management and marketing arm of Vianaar developers, has expanded rapidly since the pandemic, growing from its Goa base into major Indian cities. With 320 properties under management, the company emphasises reliability, quality and curated “wow moments” for leisure travellers.

items.title: Pride Hotels Group Broadens its Ambition Across India’s Diverse Hospitality Landscape
items.snippet: In an exclusive interview with Satyen Jain, Chief Executive Officer, Pride Hotels Limited, the conversation goes beyond the numbers driving the company’s expansion to examine the opportunities and challenges shaping Indian hospitality today. With an IPO planned, Pride is expanding its footprint while responding to changing travel patterns. Excerpts from the interview.

items.title: It’s a wrap! THINC Indonesia 2026
items.snippet: It’s a wrap! THINC Indonesia 2026 by Hotelivate | Oct 9, 2026 THINC Indonesia 2026 brought together hotel owners, investors, operators, developers, advisors and technology leaders for two days of conversations on what is shaping hospitality across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. The tone was optimistic, but measured.
